classes.scope: Current official_overlap_split_20261025: 20 train + 6 test; 2048x1024; tripod cleaned RGB
classes.source: Original official IRIS COCO 16 classes; instance-level Codex visual corrections are separately recorded. Not SAM candidate semantics.

classes.name: piping
classes.definition: 工艺输送管路及其附着的阀体、执行器和压力表。
classes.include: 直管、弯管、保温外层、法兰、阀门、管路附属执行器及仪表
classes.exclude: 独立泵/电机/容器、通风管、桥架、支撑杆
prompts: industrial process pipes with valve fittings
insulated fluid pipes and attached valve actuators
pressure gauges attached to industrial pipework
classes.rationale: 阀门占球面约0.299%，并入连续管路，避免小阀件成为独立稀碎类别。

classes.name: equipment
classes.definition: 独立机械和电气装置及其机壳、柜箱、固定灯具。
classes.include: 泵、电机、容器、控制柜、接线箱、设备外壳、固定灯具
classes.exclude: 工艺管路附着阀件和仪表、土建基座、金属支撑、风道
prompts: pumps motors vessels and equipment housings
electrical boxes and fixed industrial light fixtures
classes.rationale: 合并机械设备、电气箱柜和较少的电气设备，保持独立装置与管路/结构的边界；9类中明确设备外壳按对象恢复。

classes.name: building
classes.definition: 建筑围护与土建主体，含门、地坪、混凝土基座及低矮台座边沿。
classes.include: 地面、墙顶、建筑柱、混凝土基础、建筑门；逐对象确认的黄黑警示边沿、平台裙边及侧面；去相机支架后补全的底部地面
classes.exclude: 金属立柱与支撑底脚、机柜、风道、栏杆及格栅；未确认的其他杂项
prompts: industrial building floors walls and ceilings
concrete foundations columns and architectural doors
industrial floor curbs and low platform edges with yellow black warning stripes
classes.rationale: 门与土建结构合并；按用户确认将低矮警示边沿与底部补全地面归入建筑，保留与细长金属支撑的区别。

classes.name: structural_frame
classes.definition: 承重和固定管线/设备的金属立柱、横撑、梁及其连接底脚。
classes.include: 穿孔型钢立柱、横撑、支架、吊架、金属梁、支撑件连接底脚
classes.exclude: 设备外壳、栏杆与梯具、线缆桥架、混凝土基座；不能仅凭细长形状把电缆或管道改入
prompts: metal support columns and steel cross braces
perforated steel strut frames supporting industrial pipes
metal beams brackets and bolted support feet
classes.rationale: 原6梁类约0.229%，与24支撑件合并；原9仅对白名单中经RGB确认的细长金属支撑逐对象纠正。

classes.name: access_structure
classes.definition: 人员检修通行、登高和防护设施。
classes.include: 格栅平台、护栏、扶手、爬梯与护笼
classes.exclude: 管道支撑、桥架、混凝土地坪
prompts: industrial access ladders safety railings and grating platforms
maintenance walkways guardrails and caged ladders
classes.rationale: 格栅约0.130%、梯具约0.813%；与护栏统一成可辨认的检修通行设施。

classes.name: cable_tray
classes.definition: 承载和组织线缆的网篮或槽式桥架。
classes.include: 网篮桥架、槽式桥架的可见主体
classes.exclude: 独立梁架、格栅平台、游离电缆、管道
prompts: industrial cable baskets and cable routing trays
classes.rationale: 约8.900%球面面积，覆盖全部视角；外形与用途明确，保持独立。

classes.name: hvac
classes.definition: 通风系统风道、风口及明确属于该系统的外壳。
classes.include: 金属风道、波纹圆风管、风口
classes.exclude: 工艺输送管、独立储罐、桥架
prompts: industrial ventilation ducts and air vents
metal HVAC ductwork with corrugated round ducts
classes.rationale: 约3.850%球面面积；与工艺管保留功能差别，不因同为长管外观而合并。

semantic_source_codes.1: official labels mapped into merged taxonomy
semantic_source_codes.2: official miscellaneous region reassigned after Codex RGB inspection
semantic_source_codes.3: reconstructed nadir floor assigned building by user request; synthetic RGB provenance, not official truth
semantic_source_codes.4: former ignored component merged into its adjacent majority class; derived completion, not official truth

classes.geometry_policy: Preserve existing official CAD projected boundaries. This is class consolidation and selected object reassignment, not full boundary/occlusion relabeling.
classes.artifact_policy: All pixels have one of seven semantic classes. Reconstructed bottom floor remains building. Original RGB observation masks are preserved independently.
classes.legacy_models_note: Existing checkpoints and previous default vocabulary are unchanged; training/evaluation must explicitly use this taxonomy and matching labels.
classes.user_requested_revision: v4: merge all residual ignored regions into neighboring classes; retain v3 curbs and bottom floor as building.

residual_official_ids.9: Reviewed objects keep their assigned class; remaining holes merge into adjacent classes.
residual_official_ids.13: No separate fire class; residual regions merge into adjacent classes.

residual_completion.method: Per 8-connected v3 ignore component, select most frequent class among 4-neighbor boundary pixels; deterministic lowest-ID tie break. Decisions use unchanged v3 labels.

coordinate_system: fixed OpenMVG world, camera axes +X right,+Y down,+Z ERP center; absolute RMX center minus shared origin
repair_policy: Use fixed repaired RGB and all seven-class labels for supervision and primary full-frame evaluation. RGB synthesis provenance is kept separately. No reannotation or repair.
split_history: Test image feature overlap was previously consulted for choosing the user-approved interpolation split; fixed before current experiments. Not a blind randomly sampled benchmark.

evaluation_protocol.rgb: full repaired ERP2048x1024; arithmetic mean across6 held-out test views; final10k checkpoint only
evaluation_protocol.semantic: GT nearest-neighbor256x128;7x8 confusion includes uncovered prediction column; uncovered valid GT is always an error; pooled mIoU and per-image metrics reported separately

generated_semantic_note: Wan360 RGB frames are geometry inputs only; no generated labels are fabricated. Train supervision uses exactly20 repaired real labels.
